name: com.gamedirector.unity
description: In-game bridge for the GameDirector AI director kernel: HTTP JSON-RPC server (play mode), deterministic timeline host, cinematic camera rig, frame capture, and the generic scene adapter base class. Game-specific adapters extend this package. Depends on the precompiled GameDirector.Core.dll in Plugins/ (rebuild via tools/build_core_dll.sh in the GameDirector repo).
